auditor_value: Statements II, III are true, but statement I is false
question_defect: Spelling errors in the printed question: "avagadro's" for Avogadro's and "Boltzman's" for Boltzmann's. They do not affect the answer.
notes: My own reading: (I) false, a gas expands far more than a liquid for the same temperature rise, so a gas thermometer is more sensitive, not less; (II) true, k = R/N_A by definition; (III) true, at constant pressure V is proportional to T for a fixed mass, so rho = m/V is inversely proportional to T. That gives II and III true with I false, option 3. Both common_mistakes entries map to the right options: believing I as printed makes all three true (option 1), and rejecting II and III leaves all three false (option 4). Step 0 carries no equation, but its text is the whole substance of the statement-I judgement, so it is not an empty step.
